members.name: Jennifer Garcia
members.about:
I’m a therapist of over 20 years, but there’s so much more to me than that! I love psychology, understanding people, being creative, and coming up with ideas that bring people together. I started Promote With Confidence™ because I genuinely love helping people believe in what they’re building and find the confidence to put themselves out there.

I’m also a wife, stepmom, crazy cat lady, and psychic medium! I love anything spiritual or paranormal, learning new things, and honestly, I tend to get a little carried away when I have a new idea. lol

What really makes me happy is seeing people succeed, especially when they didn’t think they could. I love cheering people on, making connections, and creating spaces where everyone feels like they belong.
